newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BoE's George-forex inflows complicate rate policy.
newsitem.headline: BoE's George-forex inflows complicate rate policy.

text.p: Foreign exchange flows into sterling by investors seeking a safe haven were an added policy complication rather than a distorting factor, Bank of England (BOE) governor Eddie George said on Monday.

Asked by Reuters Financial Television whether safe haven flows into sterling, the dollar and the Swiss franc compelled affected central banks to pursue easier than desired monetary policy, George said:
"You are constrained. That is reality. Overall I do not accept that it would have that distorting of an effect. It is just an added complication that you have to try to deal with."
George's comments come only one day before the start of a two-day meeting of the BOE's new monetary policy committee.
Many analysts think the comittee will decide to increase base rates by 25 basis points to 6.5 percent.
